products.title: Bed - Viktor - By Draga & Aurel
products.description_html: The Viktor bed is a product of the partnership with the Draga&Aurel studio. A piece with a minimalist, elegant design that invites you to indulge in the comfort of the soft quilted cushion of the headboard. It is this welcoming surface that becomes the focal point of the model. The upholstered cushioning, covered in finely quilted leather and finished with delicate decorative stitching, rests softly on the headboard, encouraging you to rest. The feet in precious antiqued metal slim the classic lines of the structure, adding a touch of sophisticated lightness. Viktor is an iconic bed that celebrates Baxter's craftsmanship and expertise in combining materials.

products.title: Bed - Stone - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: Sinuous geometries, rounded forms and soft volumes are the design features of Stone, a bed with a large padded headboard designed by Federico Peri for Baxter. The inspiration is the Japanese Zen garden with its bevelled stones delicately arranged in the sand according to a precise principle of balance and harmony. The Stone bed consists of an extra-large modular headboard which, with its rounded edges, resembles a river stone smoothed by time and water. A solid element that gently contrasts with the softness of the leather upholstery. The modular nature of the headboard also makes it possible to adjust the heights and widths of its components, which can be accessorised with single-leg tables complete with integrated adjustable light. One touch and the magic is revealed: the table lights up!

products.title: Bed - So Soft - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: So Soft embodies comfort and security. The rounded bed devised by Studiopepe for Baxter invites you to indulge in the embrace of its curvy, upholstered contours, gently contained at the corners by tubular metal details, available in hand-brushed burnished metal or polished chrome metal. Upholstered in leather, the bed’s soft contours give the feeling of a cosy nest of tranquillity, a reassuring refuge that encourages comfort and rest.

products.title: Bed - Paris Slim - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: A bed that evokes comfort and relaxation, made with a simple and elegant design; Paris Slim fully represents the special characteristics of the union between Baxter and Paola Navone. The bed celebrates Navone’s attention to detail and ability to devise accessories with innovative and cosy designs like dog baskets, in which you can snuggle up and be cradled. Any rigidity is smoothed out by the fine, raw-cut workmanship of the leather, which rests naturally on the structure to form incredibly soft and comfortable upholstery, grazing the floor with fluid movements. Paris Slim is a bed that is as cosy as an embrace, a nest in which you can abandon yourself to complete repose.

products.title: Bed - Paris - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Paris is a bed upholstered in soft leather that elevates the idea of comfort and relaxation. Its design represents a perfect mix of elegance and comfort, the ideal synthesis of the union between Baxter and Paola Navone. The bed celebrates the designer’s attention to detail, her ability to conceive products with shapes as cosy as an embrace, in which you can curl up and be cradled. Any rigidity is smoothed out here by the workmanship of the raw-cut leather, which, resting loosely on the structure to form fine, ultra-soft upholstery, creates undulating movements that graze the floor with the smoothness of a tailored suit.

products.title: Bed - Milano - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Born from a desire for maximum comfort, Paola Navone's Milano collection includes the extra-padded leather bed: a generously sized piece with extra-large volumes and large, enveloping and reassuring cushions. The large bed is reminiscent of a cosy, welcoming nest inspired by the comforts of home which invites you to indulge in its soft, fluffy, cloud-like forms. The workmanship of the leather - quilted like a mattress and decorated by beautiful double-layered stitching - encourages you to fall into the embrace of the oversized padding of the headboard and allow yourself to drift off into a regenerating sleep.

products.title: Bed - Miami Soft - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The Miami Soft leather bed adds a touch of extra comfort to the bedroom with a generous and welcoming design and refined leather workmanship that conveys all the sophisticated sensuality that Paola Navone brings to all her designs. The soft, curvy headboard and generous padded edges of this alluring modern double bed are an open invitation to lie down, rest and recuperate. A cultured and informal celebration of the warmth and intimacy of the bedroom, the corner of the house dedicated to rest and relaxation and true soul of the home.

products.title: Bed - Heaven - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: As its name suggests, Heaven is the bed for those who wish to elevate the sleeping experience to new levels of comfort and elegance. Designed by Paola Navone for Baxter, Heaven immediately stands out for its distinctive leather headboard. Oversized, with its hand-crafted tufted work and impressive upholstery, the headboard has a monumental presence that outlines and envelops the space and its occupants. The soft, extra-large contours of each element of the bed are like a cuddle that welcomes during sleep and makes the time spent in its embrace heavenly.

products.title: Bed - Couche - By Baxter
products.description_html: Couche Extra is certainly one of Baxter’s most impressive beds. The standout feature of the bed’s design is the impressive upholstered headboard, a monumental element made up of four removable strips, featuring leather upholstery finished with exquisite hand-stitching. The large headboard with a velvet back forms a soft shield, an extra-large barrier that protects the resting person from the outside world and envelops the bed in an embrace thanks to the possibility of moving the two additional side strips.

products.title: Bed - Clara - By Christophe Delcourt
products.description_html: The Clara bed designed by Christophe Delcourt allows you to play around with the possibility of adding (or removing) a highly functional detail from the frame: the built-in bedside tables. The table tops are suspended and perfectly integrated in the organic lines of the large leather bed whose natural forms create concave and convex curves that encourage total relaxation and rest.

products.title: Bed - Casablanca - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The Casablanca bed designed by Paola Navone for Baxter stands out for the refined simplicity of its forms. An informal, relaxed design made irresistibly inviting by its soft padding and leather upholstery. Spacious and elegant, the upholstered bed consists of a frame topped by a generous headboard which folds down to form two large pillows that invite you to snuggle down and sleep, read or just simply relax. An all-round celebration of our need to enjoy a well-deserved rest, a bedroom accessory of timeless elegance that lends style and originality to any home.

products.title: Bed - Aura Slim - By Hannes Peer
products.description_html: A refined creation by Hannes Peer for Baxter, Aura Slim is a bed with a sleek, sophisticated profile that transforms the modern bedroom into a true sanctuary of elegance. A minimalist evolution of the iconic Aura model, it retains its sculptural soul while adopting a lighter, more slender silhouette—perfect for harmonising with contemporary spaces. Its distinctive base in folded aluminium—crafted using advanced folding techniques and available in exclusive chromed or lacquered finishes—offers a surprising floating effect, visually light and seemingly defying gravity. The robust inner frame ensures lasting durability, while the contoured padding embraces the body, guiding it towards deep, regenerative rest. The bed frame, wrapped in Baxter’s signature ultra-soft leather, adds a tactile dimension that gently envelops the structure, enhancing a refined design that elevates any bedroom into a place of quiet prestige.

products.title: Bed - Aura - By Hannes Peer
products.description_html: Designed by Hannes Peer for Baxter, Aura is a double bed that redefines the sleep experience by combining the essence of contemporary architecture with exceptional comfort. A sophisticated evolution of the modular Aura sofa, this bed expresses graceful lightness through its floating aluminium frame—available in polished chrome or lacquered finishes that masterfully play with light. The solid internal structure guarantees enduring strength, while the sculpted padding cradles the body in a soft embrace, encouraging a deeply restorative sleep. Wrapped in sensuous, full-grain leather, the bed frame outlines the profile with sculptural elegance—transforming any bedroom into a space of refined beauty. The two generously padded headboards, meticulously shaped, create a harmonious visual flow while offering ideal ergonomic support. Aura becomes a symbol of contemporary luxury, designed for night spaces that aspire to both exclusivity and emotional warmth.

products.title: Bed - Ultrasound
products.description_html:
Bed upholstered in leather or fabric, headboard composed by a structure in poplar plywood and bands padded and upholstered one by one, creating a three-dimensional patter decorated with polished stainless steel friezes. To be wall mounted. Bed frame with structure in plywood, padded in polyurethane foam and decorated with quilting. Bed can be provided disassembled. Plinth in polished stainless steel. Predisposed for wooden slats supported by four corner brackets and one central rod, with adjustable height. The metal parts are available with any ﬁnish included in the metal ﬁnish selection.
Shown with bed linings, pillows and bedcover Techno.

products.title: Bed - Ripley
products.description_html:
Upholstered bed with quilted headboard in leather or fabric, framed by a wooden proﬁle covered in leather or fabric with a metal proﬁle. Headboard sides embedded in the frame covered in leather or woven, slightly padded. Available with LED courtesy light on the sides of the head with touch switches. Sommier in leather or fabric inlaid with brass proﬁles around the bed frame. Internal structure in solid and multilayer wood. Predisposed for wooden slats supported by four corner brackets and one central rod, with adjustable height.
Shown with bed linings, pillows and bedcover: Epoque.

products.title: Bed - Reverie
products.description_html:
Upholstered bed in leather or fabric with high head divided into two horizontal sections with different inclination. The external part can be covered in contrast with the inner part, divided by a leather thread. Padded sommier with inwardly inclined bed frame; polished lacquered wooden base with decorative satin brass corners. Internal structure in solid and multilayer wood. Predisposed for wooden slats, supported by four corner brackets and one central rod, with adjustable height, in varnished steel. Metal parts available in the metal ﬁnishing selection.

Available in RÊVERIE RADICA version with burr walnut outer shell in 100 gloss ﬁnish. Shown with bed linings, pillows and bedcover: Chambre Cinq.

products.title: Bed - Plaza
products.description_html: Bed upholstered in leather or fabric; headboard divided in 2 parts with plywood structure padded in polyurethane foam, upholstered plain or assembled with geometrical pattern. Decorative lateral elements in curved satinized stainless steel. Central part with cushion in polyurethane and acrylic fibre with zip closure. Wooden sommier with shaped plinth in satinized stainless steel and upper part slightly padded and upholstered in satin, equipped with a supporting mattress. Metal parts available in the satinized metal finishing selection. Courtesy LED light under the sommier also available. Predisposed for wall fixing. Shown with bed linings, pillows and bedcover Pacific.

products.title: Bed - Leonardo
products.description_html:
Bed covered in leather or fabric. Headboard structure in poplar plywood and plywood infills. Headboard padding in polyurethane with 30 kg/m3 density with stovepipe working, padded and covered individually. Upper frame and plinth in thick stainless steel, joined by two steel concave profiles with LED courtesy light with on/off switch device. Bedframe in poplar plywood 25 mm with elements padded and covered individually. The headboard can be equipped with optional LED reading spotlights. Predisposed for wooden slats, supported by four corner brackets and one central rod, with adjustable height, in varnished steel. Cover of headboard and bedframe not removable. The metal parts are available in the metal finishes selection.
Shown with Vinci bed complements.

products.title: Bed - Hemingway
products.description_html:
Bed upholstered in leather or fabric. Internal structure in solid wood and shaped plywood; padding in polyurethane foam in different densities. Shaped headboard internally finished with padded panels, individually upholstered. Sommier with mul- ti-faceted angles, equipped with bench with seat cushions in polyurethane and Memory Foam® and goose down. Backrest padded in individually upholstered panels. Decorative zipper on base, armrests and backrest available in gold, antiqued brass and black nickel. Predisposed for wooden slats, supported by four corner brackets and one central rod, with adjustable height, in varnished steel. Base in lacquered MDF.
Shown with bed linings, pillows and bedcover Sylvia.

products.title: Bed - Emotion
products.description_html:
Bed upholstered in leather or fabric. Structure of the headboard in plywood covered in veneered wood with polish lacquering, padded panels upholstered one-by-one, two hidden storage compartments with flap-door opening system, internally upholstered in leather or fabric. Integrated bedside table. Headboard and bedframe plinth in wood, inserts in satinized stainless steel. Equipped for wall-mounting. Bedframe in plywood padded with polyurethane. Predisposed for wooden slats, supported by four corner brackets and one central rod, with adjustable height, in varnished steel. All the storage compartments are equipped with LED lights. Metal parts available in the metal finishing selection.
Shown with bed linings, pillows and bedcover: Isydor.

products.title: Bed - Embrace Radica
products.description_html: Upholstered bed with a quilted leather or fabric headboard, framed by a wooden profile covered externally in leather or fabric and internally in burl walnut wood with a 100 gloss finish. The edge is covered by a leather piping. The upper band of the headboard, with a quilted diamond pattern, is illuminated by a LED courtesy light and the headrest is made of three fixed cushions upholstered in polyurethane and covered in leather or fabric. The bed base is covered in leather or fabric, with an angular wooden profile matching the headboard. The internal structure is made of solid and multi-layered wood, with a slatted base in solid wood. The bed base and mattress supports are adjustable in height.

products.title: Bed - Le Comte
products.description_html: Padded bed in leather or fabric. Headboard in curved plywood and headrest cushion padded with polyurethane foam. Headrest upholstered in leather or fabric decorated with embroidered logo and pillow inside the headrest provided with contrasting upholstery. Headboard decorative profile in polished aluminium. Bed frame in wood plywood divided in 3 parts, upholstered in leather or fabric, lower and upper edges with contrasting upholstery. Feet and headboard profiles in aluminium. Metal parts available with chrome or gold finish. Suitable for Visionnaire slats and mattresses. Slats supporting brackets with adjustale height.

products.title: Bed - Bradley
products.description_html:
Headboard with shaped plywood structure, quilted panels in polyurethane and upholstered in fabric or leather, headboard frame and base in polished stainless steel. Headboard predisposed for wall fixing ready. Predisposed for wooden slats, supported by four corner brackets and one central rod, with adjustable height, in varnished steel. Metal parts available in the metal finishing selection.
Shown with bed linings, pillows and bedcover Koralyn.

products.title: Bed - Beloved
products.description_html:
Bed upholstered in leather or fabric. Upholstered headboard with geometrical pattern, structure in plywood with slightly padded panels upholstered individually. Plinth and inserts in satinized stainless steel with engraved logo, predisposed for wall fixing. Bed base in plywood padded in polyurethane, made of several elements individually upholstered, decorated with four inserts in satinized stainless steel. Base in satinized stainless steel. Predisposed for wooden slats, supported by four corner brackets and one central rod, with adjustable height, in varnished steel. Metal parts available in the metal finishing selection.
Shown with bed linings and bedcover Ernon.

products.title: Bed - Beloved Art
products.description_html:
Bed upholstered in leather or fabric. Headboard padded in leather or fabric. Headboard padded as to design a geometric pattern; structure in plywood panels and solid wood with slightly padded tiles, upholstered one by one. Plinth and decorative elements inserted into bed base and headboard in stainless steel with satin finish. Storage compartment with back panel decorated with artistic artwork by Michele Astolfi made in printed polycarbonate and decorated with inserts in artistic glass and Swarovski crystals. Available in the subjects: Leaves, Peacock, Dune. LED courtesy lights. Headboard provided disassembled and designed to be installed on the wall. Bed base in plywood padded with polyurethane foam, consisting of several elements upholstered one by one and decorated with inserts and base in satin stainless steel. Predisposed for wooden slats, supported by four corner braces and one central rod in lacquered steel, adjustable in height.
The storage compartment is available with back panel in marble or upholstered in leather or fabric. Decorative metal elements can be finished with any lacquer of the metal lacquer finish selection.

Shown with bed linings, pillows and bedcover Cala Luna.

products.title: Bed - Neolito Bold
products.description_html: Upholstered bed in leather or fabric. The asymmetrical polygonal headboard is fully upholstered, with a structure in multi-layered wood and solid fir wood, covered in polyurethane foam with differentiated densities and ergonomic padding, it is designed for electrical outlets (available on request). Bedframe in standard shape or available with an asymmetric polygonal pouf configuration on request, made up of three upholstered elements. Predisposed for a wooden slatted bed base, with a support structure consisting of four corner pieces and a central crossbar, adjustable in height, made of painted steel. The BOLD version is available in leather only, with decorative quilting in irregular bands, individually stitched together using tailoring techniques, padded with acrylic layer and applied seamlessly. The standard version features a headboard that is divided into three parts.

products.title: Bed - Neolito
products.description_html: Upholstered bed in leather or fabric. The asymmetrical polygonal headboard is fully upholstered, with a structure in multi-layered wood and solid fir wood, covered in polyurethane foam with differentiated densities and ergonomic padding, it is designed for electrical outlets (available on request). Bedframe in standard shape or available with an asymmetric polygonal pouf configuration on request, made up of three upholstered elements. Predisposed for a wooden slatted bed base, with a support structure consisting of four corner pieces and a central crossbar, adjustable in height, made of painted steel. The BOLD version is available in leather only, with decorative quilting in irregular bands, individually stitched together using tailoring techniques, padded with acrylic layer and applied seamlessly. The standard version features a headboard that is divided into three parts.

products.title: Bed - Ca' Foscari
products.description_html: Large and Regular version: Bed with non-removable upholstery in leather or fabric; headboard with dedicated quilted embroidery. Shaped bed base with rounded profile. Structure in plywood and solid wood with integrated wooden slats, padding in differentiated-density polyurethane foam. Shaped base of headboard and bed base made in wood, covered in curved stainless steel with concave profile. Headboard and bed base are provided disassembled. Decorative metal elements can be finished with any lacquer of the metal lacquer finish selection. Shown with bed linings, pillows and bedcover Cala Luna.

products.title: Bed - Bastian
products.description_html:
BASTIAN LARGE

Bed upholstered in leather or fabric. Internal structure in solid wood and shaped plywood, padding in polyurethane foam with different densities. Shaped headboard padded and decorated with piping and edges with topstitching in leather with contrasting colour. Two decorative pillows in feather with the same upholstery are provided. Bed-frame composed by three elements padded and decorated with piping and edges in contrasting leather. Friezes on the bed frame are in aluminium and satin stainless steel, with dou- ble finish. They can be lacquered in any colour included in the metal finish selection. Predisposed for wooden slats, supported by four corner brackets and one central rod, with adjustable height, in varnished steel. LED courtesy light can be mount- ed under the headboard profile upon request. Shown with bed linings, pillows and bedcover Mirabell.

BASTIAN REGULAR

Bed upholstered in leather or fabric. Internal structure in solid wood and shaped plywood, padding in polyurethane foam with different densities. Shaped headboard padded and decorated with piping and edges with topstitching in leather with contrasting colour. Two decorative pillows in feather with the same upholstery are provided. Bed-frame composed by three elements padded and decorated with piping and edges in contrasting leather. Friezes on the bed frame are in aluminium and satin stainless steel, with double finish. They can be lacquered in any colour included in the metal finish selection. Predisposed for wooden slats, supported by four corner brackets and one central rod, with adjustable height, in varnished steel. Shown with bed linings, pillows and bedcover Mirabell.

products.title: Bed - Aubade
products.description_html: Bed upholstered in leather or fabric. Headboard made of rectangular wooden panels slightly padded and upholstered individually, separated by inlays in stainless steel. Perimetral frame with built-in marble panels with LED courtesy light. Plinth and inserts in stainless steel. Predisposed for wall fixing. Bedframe in multiply wood padded in polyurethane and made of single upholstered elements. Stainless steel base. Predisposed for wooden slats, supported by four corner brackets and one central rod, with adjustable height. The metal parts are available in the metal finishes selection.

products.description_html: This is a custom-made article. Please visit our showroom in Rotterdam for more information.
